name: @ahpd/deploy
description: Git deploy driver for ahpd: one call places service S on machine M at version X in a release folder and switches a current symlink, or says loudly why it did not. Served as x-ahpd/deploy/run and x-ahpd/deploy/report.

ahpd.title: Deploy
ahpd.description: This machine's services at a version: fetches into a release folder, builds, switches one symlink, checks. run starts and answers at once; report reads what the last deploy did.
